source: lab (captured; background replaced by chroma green via Segment Anything 2 - watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static (no background texture is left, but the squatting person's feet/head stay fixed to within ~1-2 px over all 49 frames)
camera.perspective_cues: No floor/horizon visible (green background). The floor contact line is implied by the ball bottom (y~555 at rest) and the person's shoes (y~543). The ball rolls toward the camera: its apparent diameter grows from 117.5 px to ~420 px, so its depth shrinks ~3.6x (depth ~ focal * true_diameter / pixel_diameter).

objects.name: ball
objects.description: large dark-grey (slightly bluish) exercise / gym ball with specular highlights; the only ball
objects.visible_frames: 0-46 (frame 46 only a sliver at the bottom-left edge; gone in 47-48)
objects.reference_point: centre of a circle fitted to the ball silhouette outline (cx, cy in tracks/ball.csv)

objects.name: person
objects.description: one person (face masked green), long dark hair, black T-shirt and black trousers, white shoes, squatting behind the ball and pushing it toward the camera
objects.moves: stays squatting in place (feet fixed); only arms/torso move: hands on ball 0-17, arms thrown up 18-30, arms lowered/crossed 38-48
objects.reference_point: centroid of the person mask (cx, cy) - shifts mainly due to arm motion; legs/feet fixed

static_objects: none visible (background removed); watermark box 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' at x 1030-1280, y 690-720 is not a scene object
